name: Woodcraft of St. Louis - Maryland Heights
old_description: Trusted by woodworkers since 1928, Woodcraft has built a reputation for providing quality tools, expert guidance, and exceptional customer service. Whether you're purchasing your first machine or upgrading a lifelong workshop, you can shop with confidence knowing you're choosing equipment backed by nearly a century of woodworking experience. Browse our collection to find reliable machines that help you create with precision for years to come.
about:
Woodcraft of St. Louis - Maryland Heights operates a retail store at 2077 Congressional Drive in Maryland Heights, Missouri. The location is part of the Woodcraft national chain, which has served woodworkers since 1928.

The store stocks a range of woodworking tools, lumber, and supplies from brands such as JET, Powermatic, Festool, Laguna, Rikon, WoodRiver, pfeil, Flexcut, and Veritas. In addition to retail sales, the location offers woodworking classes—such as Finishing 301: Top Coats, Woodworking Fundamentals: Cutting Board, and Date Night: Drunken Cutting Board—and hosts free monthly demonstrations and vendor events, including JessEm router lift demos.

The store serves hobbyist and professional woodworkers in the St. Louis area. Classes are capped at small groups (e.g., four to six participants) and cover topics from basic cutting-board construction to advanced finishing techniques. Events target both novice and experienced craftspeople looking to evaluate equipment.

Woodcraft positions the location as the area's premiere destination for woodworking tools, wood, supplies, and expert advice, emphasizing hands-on guidance and a curated brand selection to help customers make wood work.
